verdict.rationale: Smithery's Uplink feature explicitly exposes an MCP server running on any local machine as a regular Smithery connection, targeting exactly this use case (testing before publishing, running private tools without hosting). This is well documented as a first-party feature distinct from full publishing/deployment. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Uplink working in practice, and details on connection reliability/latency for locally-bridged servers.
